description: This file contains React components and functions for exporting and previewing chat messages, including modal dialogs, message rendering, and export options in various formats (text, image, JSON). It is part of a chat application interface.

classes.name: useSteps
classes.description: Custom hook managing step navigation in the export process.

classes.name: Steps
classes.description: Component displaying step progress and navigation.

methods.name: useSteps
methods.description: Hook for managing current step index and navigation functions.

methods.name: MessageExporter
methods.description: Main component for selecting, previewing, and exporting chat messages.

methods.name: RenderExport
methods.description: Component that renders messages for export and provides callback for processed data.

methods.name: PreviewActions
methods.description: Component providing copy, download, and share actions for message previews.

methods.name: ExportAvatar
methods.description: Component rendering avatar images based on user or bot.

methods.name: ImagePreviewer
methods.description: Component for previewing chat messages as images with copy and download options.

methods.name: MarkdownPreviewer
methods.description: Component for previewing chat messages as Markdown formatted text.

methods.name: JsonPreviewer
methods.description: Component for previewing chat messages as JSON data.
